author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
We're back with The Indie Hour Episode Eighty-Four! This series focuses on games you may have never even heard of and gives us an inside look at the wider world of independantly published Tabletop Wargames of all genres.

Do you like HEAVY METAL? Do you like LADY DEATH? How about hand-drawn art? Did you back Lancer? Tom Bloom has a new gridded-combat skirmish game about a hole. In the hole is a city. The city is sliding into hell. Like... literally. Let's check it out!

Check out the the game on itch.io HERE: https://tombloom.itch.io/magnagothica-maleghast
title: The GMG Indie Hour Ep 084 - MAGNAGOTHICA - Maleghast by Tom Bloom
